B0-113
BODY - SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER
1. SEAT BELT PRETENSIONER ACTIVATION WHEN
SCRAPPING VEHICLE
HINT: Battery
Have a battery ready as the power source to activate the seat
belt pretensioner.
MH158
(a) Check functioning of SST.
CAUTION:
When activating the seat belt pretensioner, always use the
specified SST: SRS Airbag Deployment Tool.
SST 09082-00700, 09082--00740
J\50152
(1) Connect the SST to the battery_
Connect the red clip of the SST to the battery posi­
tive ( +) terminal and the black clip to the battery neg­ Battecy
ative {-) terminal.
HINT:
Do not connect the yellow connector which will be connected
with the seat belt pretensioner.

(b) Disconnect the pretensioner connector.
H0158(1 (1) Remove the door scuff plate.
(2) Remove the package tray trim_
(3) Remove the rear seat (See page 80-102).
(4) Remove the luggage compartment trim.
(5) Remove the luggage compartment mat.
(6) Remove the rear deck trim cover.
(7) Remove the deck trim side panel.
(8) Remove the seatback hinge.
{9) Remove the seatback lock striker.
(10) Remove the rear seat outer belt floor anchor.
(11) Remove the quarter trim panel.
